Vendored copies of the two Arsenal installers that define this build's scope.

Source (upstream, archived):
  https://github.com/Azathothas/Arsenal/blob/main/misc/Linux/install_dev_tools.sh
  https://github.com/Azathothas/Arsenal/blob/main/misc/Linux/install_bb_tools.sh

Retrieved: 2026-09-13

These are vendored, not fetched, so gen_recipes.sh is hermetic and the
blackhole CI job (no external network) can still validate RECIPES.txt.

When the installers change in the Arsenal fork, update these copies in the
same commit that updates RECIPES.txt.
